messages:
Marta: Popcorn poll: Friday movie night at 7pm? vote with emoji: :popcorn: yes, :zzz: nah
Alex: :popcorn: I'm in. bringing extra buttering skills.
Noah: :popcorn: Can we also do ridiculous one-liners between scenes? low-effort, high-laugh yield.
Marta: love that. one-liner starter: 'My laptop fan is my spirit animal.'
Alex: "I renamed my Wi-Fi to 'Pretty Fly for a Wi-Fi' and now productivity is compromised."
Noah: "Accidentally closed the tab with my five-step plan to be an adult. RIP."
iris-bot: FYI: conference room B reserved Friday 6-9pm for team event. :calendar: (automated)
Marta: Quick kudos: shoutout to @Alex for fixing the sink leak this morning. real MVP. :wrench: :sparkles:
Alex: ahaha that was a team effort. shoutout to whoever left the duct tape labeled 'For emergencies only'
Noah: Mystery hero remains anonymous. also tiny bet: winner of one-liner round buys popcorn toppings.
Marta: Deal. final call: popcorn tally is unanimous. movie night confirmed.
Alex: I'll bring extra napkins and my questionable trivia about 90s sitcoms.
Noah: Can't wait. also reminder: please bring non-greasy snack options for keyboards. learned that the hard way.
Marta: noted. see you Friday. thread archived in my brain under 'good decisions'.
metadata_note: Single Slack thread string with short messages, emoji votes, a bot notice, a kudos, and quick one-liners. No title field per agents.md rules.
